name: Gilt
summary: A black and gold one-time code field with pressed-in slots whose gold rims catch the light
about: Four debossed slots sit in a black card with fine gold edges, and their rims light up wherever your pointer moves. A right code sends a foil shine across the card and turns the art deco crest into a gold medal with a check. Good for premium memberships, wallets and payment confirmation pages.
how: Move the pointer over the card and watch the gold rims catch the light
Type, paste or autofill the demo code; backspace and arrow keys move between slots
After the fourth digit the slots glint while the code is verified
A right code runs a foil shine and stamps a gold medal with a check
A wrong code turns the rims red, shakes them and clears the slots
